rows.grounds: compound object denoting signs and omens to be observed
indicates preliminary timing before the main action
prescriptive injunction for carrying out the rite

items.question: Must omens and portents be ascertained before performing ritual action?
premises: Ritual action requires proper preliminary conditions.
Omens and portents indicate favorable or unfavorable conditions.
Ascertaining signs at the outset informs correct performance.
items.inference: Therefore one should ascertain omens and portents at the outset before performing the ritual action.
uncertainties: nimittaśakunān may be read as a dvandva or as a descriptive compound.
items.plain_english: Having ascertained the omens and portents at the outset, one should perform the ritual action.
